name: Chatwoot n8n AI support Agent v7

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Normalize Event').first().json; const base = String(c.config.wooBaseUrl||'').replace(/\/$/, ''); const id = String(c.detectedOrderId||'').trim(); const email = encodeURIComponent(String(c.senderEmail||'').trim()); if (id) return `${base}/wp-json/wc/v3/orders/${id}`; if (email) return `${base}/wp-json/wc/v3/orders?search=${email}&per_page=5&orderby=date&order=desc`; return `${base}/wp-json/wc/v3/orders?per_page=1`; })() }}
